title: Headroom in a fictional 100 GB capacity test
method: Synthetic fixed 100 GB usable volume:85 GB used initially gives 15 GB free;60 GB used afterward gives 40 GB free. Data-retention requirements and workload comparability must be validated. No avoided-outage estimate is claimed.
alt: Available headroom grows from 15 GB to 40 GB in a fictional fixed-capacity test.
